independent_controls.method: For each of anomaly, contract_review, contract_renewal, upcoming_cost exercise positive authenticated HTTP using fixture synthetic records; compare exact full row groups to independent parameter-bound source SQL/oracle after JSON normalization. Include multi-row group, distinct equal-looking identities and out-of-first-page anomaly; require encoded-slash opaque key reached whole and unchanged. Frozen tests already contain relevant cases; confirm candidate runs rather than infer.

In isolated fixture TestClient/public synthetic stores require provably unknown 404, no or invalid auth 401, unauthorized source segment 403, attention-only cannot disclose details, strict missing/invalid publication 503 with no warehouse fetch. Verify detail-only and no stored-field or private marker leakage, except Busy has its established distinct response. Check each segment; actual auth policy/fixture determines usable accounts.

With actual candidate imports and a disposable PostgreSQL publication, record 200 before and after; patch actual PostgresReportingStore._connect to raise unique synthetic psycopg.OperationalError, assert 503 and marker absent/no fallback; separately inject same RuntimeError instance and assert HTTP 500 with raise_server_exceptions=False and source exception not reclassified. Never modify deployed database.

independent_controls.case: real warehouse acquisition driver busy program
independent_controls.method: Build synthetic on-disk DuckDB and real WarehouseSessionManager plus WarehouseSessionTransformationService; close idle handle, assert exact HTTP 200 before/after. At packages.storage.duckdb_store.connect_with_lock_retry raise duckdb.IOException with synthetic marker, WarehouseBusyError instance, and RuntimeError instance in separate trials. Assert factory call count and actual lower lease path; driver produces safe 503 without marker, Busy yields canonical 503 Retry-After 5/retry_after_seconds 5, programming error remains 500; separately direct source control confirms Busy/program same exception identity. Baseline source probe /tmp/hla-source-r3-a3-real-lease-probe.py and HTTP Busy probe /tmp/hla-api-source7134-busy-probe.py illustrate path but are session-local, tied to old preview, and must be rebound/reviewed against candidate.
